name: Sinopec Engineering Group
description: Sinopec's EPC and licensing arm (HKEX 2386): feasibility, technology licensing and process design, FEED and full EPC for refining and petrochemical projects at home and abroad. Technology licensing is a strategic pillar (ethylene cracking and refining licensed technologies) that feeds its downstream EPC business. Reference work: SATORP refinery expansion EPC in Saudi Arabia (won 2023), Kazakhstan butadiene plant EPC, international arm Sinopec Engineering Group Saudi.
